dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing initiated from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with a subtle asymmetrical convex deviation on the right posterior margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity reflectance across the majority of the dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low density, diffuse greyish patches concentrated primarily along the anterior-most region and central dorsal line.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between white and grey regions; high-contrast boundary at the lateral water-skin interface.
